title: PBS station fears losing 50TB of data after being ghosted by cloud storage provider
summary: Louis affiliate Nine PBS filed a lawsuit against Iron Mountain Data Centers on July 28, seeking access to the data. However, OSS is being unresponsive, and Nine PBS says Iron Mountain has refused to release its data.
